scenes.heading: Cost Management & Workload Management
scenes.narration: Controlling warehouse spend means aligning compute to workloads and putting guardrails on runaway usage.

scenes.heading: Where the money goes
bullets: Compute usually dominates the bill, driven by warehouse size and run time.
Storage is comparatively cheap but grows with time travel and clones.
Idle warehouses waste money, so auto-suspend is essential.
Bad queries that scan everything are a hidden but major cost.
scenes.narration: In most warehouses compute is the largest line item, set by how big your warehouses are and how long they run. Storage is cheap by comparison but accumulates through retention and clones. The quiet cost killers are idle warehouses and inefficient queries that scan far more data than they need.

scenes.heading: A cost governance loop
scenes.narration: Good cost control starts by attributing spend to teams so everyone sees their impact. You then set budgets with alerts and enforce hard limits that cap runaway consumption. Finally you review usage regularly and right-size warehouses that are too big or too idle.

scenes.heading: Cost control vs workload management
scenes.narration: Cost management focuses on visibility and limits so you never get a shocking invoice. Workload management focuses on isolating and prioritizing jobs so one heavy query does not starve another. The two work hand in hand: isolating workloads also makes their costs far easier to attribute.

scenes.heading: Capping spend with a resource monitor
scenes.code:
CREATE RESOURCE MONITOR monthly_cap
  WITH CREDIT_QUOTA = 1000
  FREQUENCY = MONTHLY
  START_TIMESTAMP = IMMEDIATELY
  TRIGGERS
    ON 80 PERCENT DO NOTIFY
    ON 100 PERCENT DO SUSPEND;

ALTER WAREHOUSE analytics_wh
  SET RESOURCE_MONITOR = monthly_cap;
scenes.narration: This resource monitor sets a thousand-credit budget that resets every month. At eighty percent it sends a notification, and at one hundred percent it suspends the warehouse to stop further spend. Attaching it to the analytics warehouse turns an abstract budget into an enforced, automatic guardrail.

scenes.text: Right-size compute, isolate workloads, and enforce budgets with monitors so cost stays predictable and controlled.
scenes.narration: Pair workload isolation with budgets and resource monitors, and warehouse spend becomes both predictable and enforceable.
